issue_summary.label: No Airbnb listing ID

issue_summary.label: Online bookings disabled

issue_summary.label: Guest reviews but no listing ID

issue_summary.label: No guest reviews on any OTA (90d)

issue_summary.label: Wheelhouse listing inactive

issue_summary.label: Wheelhouse rate posting off

issue_summary.label: Not active in KeyData
issue_summary.why: Renting in Streamline but not in KeyData's active set — performance for this unit is not being tracked.

issue_summary.label: Active in KeyData, not renting in Streamline

issue_summary.label: Missing from Wazzi Data

issue_summary.label: In Wazzi Data, not in Streamline

issue_summary.label: No COPS account/bank ID

issue_summary.label: No merchant / payment gateway

issue_summary.label: No area assigned
issue_summary.why: Without an area the unit cannot be routed to a brand site or region.

issue_summary.label: No neighborhood assigned
issue_summary.why: Neighborhood drives site placement and search.

issue_summary.label: No location resort assigned
issue_summary.why: Location resort drives grouping on the branded sites.

issue_summary.label: No property group assigned
issue_summary.why: Property group drives reporting and accounting rollups.

issue_summary.label: Property group / state mismatch
